limits: Post-hoc stress test, not preregistered confirmation or a replacement for the primary 16-group result.
Only four highly unequal groups; cluster intervals are exploratory and support no significance claim.
All groups still share primitive actions; this does not guarantee action-, semantic-task-, or environment-disjoint generalization.
No new encoder/VLM inference, no threshold or hyperparameter tuning, and no regrouping after scores.

definitions.denominator: All selected samples, including missing/failed/invalid predictions.
definitions.macro_f1: Mean F1 over the fixed labels success and failure; abstentions are false negatives for their true class; undefined class F1 is zero.
definitions.balanced_accuracy: Mean of success recall and failure recall; undefined when either ground-truth class is absent.
definitions.selective_accuracy: Correct / answered only; secondary to accuracy and must be read together with coverage.
definitions.scope: Before/after subtask outcome verification; no temporal onset localization is measured.

bootstrap.warning: Fewer than 10 independent task groups: percentile intervals are exploratory and may be unstable. They do not establish generalization to new environments or robots.
